blind.description: A stylized ritual idol or chess-like monument featuring a layered cylindrical pedestal with alternating dark charcoal stone and pale ivory bands. The top of the pedestal supports a smooth, upward-pointing ivory crescent horn structure that cradles a pale sphere or orb in its center. All surfaces are clean, solid, and continuous, with smooth stone or carved ivory textures and no floating or melted geometry.
blind.from_above: An elongated ivory crescent shape framing a central pale sphere, sitting atop concentric circular base rings, vaguely resembling a stylized eye.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.2 times as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 7 ft tall), with a base width of about 2.5 ft.
